findings.message: GSAP tween on "#holding" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: left, top. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine — animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace left/top with the transform equivalent (x, y) — e.g. tl.fromTo("#holding", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: GSAP tween on "#buy" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: left, top, fontSize. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine — animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace left/top with the transform equivalent (x, y) — e.g. tl.fromTo("#buy", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }); do not animate fontSize (they reflow text and snap glyph positions): replace fontSize with scale (same visual, no reflow). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.

findings.message: <section id="scene-1"> has timing attributes but no class="clip". The runtime still hides it outside its time range, but Studio and the GSAP clip-ownership rules use .clip to recognise a clip, so leaving it off makes the element harder to edit and to lint.
findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.
